API Documentation

Navigation on the left must not appear in a Clean Document export.

Getting started

const client = new Client({ apiKey });
const result = await client.capture({
  mode: 'element',
  quality: 'balanced',
});
console.log(result.pageCount);

1. The capture must reproduce this paragraph exactly as it appears on screen. Selectable text is the defining property of a Document mode export.

2. Page breaks should fall between paragraphs rather than through a line of text. A tiled capture must not repeat this line at a seam boundary.

3. Selectable text is the defining property of a Document mode export. Margins are measured from the trimmed content, not from the viewport.

4. A tiled capture must not repeat this line at a seam boundary. The capture must reproduce this paragraph exactly as it appears on screen.
